summary: Validated apex/www CORS + relative browser API/file path fix in preview. Backend auth regressions and frontend login-origin flow passed; production frontend build also passed.
action_items: No blocking defects found in requested scope.
Proceed to redeploy production with current fix set and monitor apex/www auth logs for first post-deploy window.
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend browser client enforces same-origin requests via API_BASE='/api' and fileUrl(path)=path in browser runtime, preventing apex/www cross-origin cookie/CORS mismatch.
Backend expand_origin_variants correctly expands only explicit custom apex/www domains and avoids broadening preview subdomains.

Auth playbook checks passed: bcrypt '$2b$' seed hash format, HttpOnly+Secure cookies, credentialed explicit-origin CORS preflight, brute-force lockout after 5 failures, and seed_admin idempotent password update.
seed_data_creation: No manual seed script created. Existing regression tests create temporary users and clean up after execution.
context_for_next_testing_agent: UI validation used preview URL from frontend/.env and super admin credentials from /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Captured POST request confirmed active-origin call: https://lanjut-core.preview.emergentagent.com/api/auth/login and successful redirect to /admin/dashboard.
rca of the issue: Original production-only failure came from apex/www alias mismatch: browser on https://www.rilismusik.com called absolute https://rilismusik.com/auth endpoints and was blocked by credentialed CORS (missing Access-Control-Allow-Origin for requesting origin). Mitigation validated here: browser API/file calls remain relative (/api, internal file paths), eliminating alias-induced cross-origin requests; backend explicit custom-domain CORS expansion now includes apex<->www safely without broadening preview subdomains. No API flow is MOCKED.
